usedFor: Fibery holds your work entities, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers when “New Entity” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Entity” in Fibery, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new Fibery entity can start a script on your own machine, such as a backup or a build.

watchOut: “Entity Updated or Created” in Fibery also fires on edits, so the same entity can run the command twice.
